grades: Volunteers: middle and high school students. TAG: grades 7 to 12.
duration: Weekly assignments or one-time tasks. TAG meets monthly.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The library tries to help students who need school service hours, with advance notice.
name: Student Volunteers and Teen Advisory Group (TAG)
what_you_do: Volunteer on weekly or one-time tasks. These include office work, processing new materials and helping in a computer class. You also keep the picture book room neat. TAG members help shape teen programs and meet once a month.
who_can_apply: Middle school students, high school students and adults can apply. Students under 17 need a parent to say yes. The library cannot give drop-in volunteer work. It also cannot give court-ordered community service.
deadline_text: No deadline stated. Completed applications are held for six months. Volunteer openings are limited.
how_to_apply: Fill out the student volunteer application (a PDF from the volunteer page) or pick one up at the Welcome or Information Desk. Contact Laura Stone, Volunteer Coordinator, (847) 244-5150 ext. 3059, lstone@wnpl.info. For TAG, complete the registration form on the TAG page.
notes: Adults who apply must agree to a background check for crimes. The page says TAG is a good way to earn volunteer hours for National Honor Society and other service rules.
